name: Insolation Energy Ltd.
summary: Insolation Energy Ltd., founded in 2015 and headquartered in Jaipur, Rajasthan, is one of India's top-10 solar PV module manufacturers. The company manufactures a range of high-efficiency solar PV modules and is expanding into solar cell manufacturing and Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) to become a fully vertically integrated clean energy platform. The company's 200 MW SPV Module manufacturing unit is located in Jaipur.
